title: Android to Add Gemini Scam Warnings and Banking Protection
excerpt: Google is introducing new Android features powered by Gemini to warn users about suspicious messages and protect banking data during screen sharing.
body_html:
Google is integrating Gemini technology into Android to help protect users from fraudulent messages and safeguard sensitive financial information. According to the announcement, the system is designed to identify when a potential scammer is attempting to send a message.

Additionally, the new security measures aim to shield banking details from unauthorized viewing while users are sharing their screens. These upcoming features utilize advanced artificial intelligence to detect threats directly on the device, offering an extra layer of defense against modern mobile scams and privacy risks.
